bagPolicy.summary: Palau Sant Jordi allows only basic personal items such as a phone, wallet or handbag, and states no bag size. A cloakroom costs 2 EUR per item.
prohibited: Throwable objects beyond basic personal items
Cans, bottles or containers over 500 ml
bagPolicy.note: Cloakroom available at 2 EUR per item. Pushchairs can come in but must be left at the cloakroom (2 EUR). The full prohibited items list is shown as an image on the FAQ page.

parking.note: Parking availability, access routes, and pricing at Palau Sant Jordi can vary by event. Review the linked official information and reserve in advance when that option is offered.

rideshare.note: Plan your return trip before the concert. Traffic controls limit taxi access after shows. The venue suggests public transport or arranging pickup nearby.

concessions.note: The bars at Palau Sant Jordi offer a wide variety of food and drinks including hot and cold sandwiches, snacks, and options for vegetarians and gluten-free products. The venue encourages recycling with designated bins for different types of waste.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Buy reduced mobility tickets only through the official sales channels, including if you expect to be on crutches. Request special assistance through the form in the contact section, and note that only one companion can come in with you. Reduced mobility (PRM) parking is on Avenida del Estadio and Paseo Olímpico.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Palau Sant Jordi's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office only opens on the day of the event, usually 1 hour before the doors open.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: The reduced mobility (PRM) entrance is signposted. Once inside, staff can guide you and up to one companion to your seat.
